comments.author: ejnburrows-rgb
comments.body:
Implemented in exact commit `97354ea934f47c4f2f4d91767d7f12977d42ba60`. The alpha reporter now validates a full 40-character hexadecimal commit before invoking Git and separates the fixed show command with --end-of-options. Direct CLI regression rejects an option-shaped head before opening the PDF.

[Repair and 8/8 focused boundary results](https://github.com/ejnburrows-rgb/cartilla-de-gretel/blob/97354ea934f47c4f2f4d91767d7f12977d42ba60/docs/proofs/m7-m8-m9-verification/continuation/HELPER-SECURITY-REPAIR.md); [independent exact-commit affected-delta review and alert mapping](https://github.com/ejnburrows-rgb/cartilla-de-gretel/blob/4359aecef5294e3a43722c47ee73fc4efa9e9eb6/docs/proofs/m7-m8-m9-verification/continuation/independent-review-helper-guards.md). This is remediation-based discussion resolution, not alert dismissal or formal PR approval. Hostile concurrent filesystem replacement and operator-selected executable integrity remain outside the demonstrated guarantee. Overall merge/release HOLD remains for separate performance, source, final-evidence and formal-review gates.
